capabilities: Run timed exam simulations from Markdown notes with countdown, passing threshold and result report
Play untimed quizzes from the same notes with instant per-question feedback
Collect missed questions in an error pool governed by a 2x-mastery rule
Mix random module question sets as exams or quizzes from a dashboard
Track XP, streaks and a tamagotchi dragon companion, synced via a Markdown progress file
extras: README is written in German. Installation is recommended via BRAT (repository tobiasottost-cmd/obsidian-quiz-hub) rather than the community store; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian. Progress syncing relies on an exams/progress.md file whose embedded JSON block must not be edited manually. AI-generated question prompts are meant to be pasted into external chat models; the plugin itself works fully offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown notes into timed exam simulations or interactive quizzes with scoring, feedback and progress tracking.

requires.name: optional language model (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for the copy-paste question-generation prompts

summary: Offline exam simulator and quiz hub that runs timed exams and untimed quizzes from Markdown notes, with scoring, an error pool and spaced repetition.
